text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon has opened a four-length
lead! And it looks like
she's going to keep
it!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon leads! 2,400 meters can't stop
her from going gate to wire!
Six for six!
The undefeated Double Crown is hers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice finishes the Japanese Derby in
second. She may have failed to
overtake
Mihono Bourbon, but it's huge progress
nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I take the team to an
amusement park in Chiba.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! We're here—the amusement park of
dreams! With the
princess's castle, and Big
Lightning Mountain!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be nice to treat her to the
theme park she's always
wanted to go to,
but, well...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wait... There's no one else here.
It's like
our very own kingdom. Hehe.
That sounds
nice. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Rice here truly believes this is the
place she's been so keen
on visiting...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen whispers into my ear as an
oblivious Rice Shower beams
with
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I know money's tight this month, but did you really have to bring her to this amusement park?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeahhh...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeahhh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, McQueen! Rumor has it there's a
mystery attraction
underground. We gotta
uncover the truth!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: H-hey! That door is for employees only!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Let's get going too, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, all right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They say time flies when you're having
fun,
so I guess that means we
had fun, location
notwithstanding.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We got to go on almost every ride. Good
thing there weren't many
people today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every time she expresses genuine joy at
being here, I feel a little
pang of guilt.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hey, um... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to end the day by going on the
ferris wheel. So, um... would
you join me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, she's too pure—my heart can't take
it... If she wants to ride the
ferris wheel,
then the ferris wheel it is.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The city rolls on and on as far as the eye
can see, dyed orange by the
setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...But the breathtaking sight is lost on
Rice
Shower. Something's been
bugging her
ever since we got on.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, um... It's just...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to say thank you. For everything.
I really didn't think I'd be
able to achieve
so much.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I mean, I still can't believe that I got second place in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...So,
that got me thinking. I'm happy with
second place, but... what if
I could be
first?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to win.
Against Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her ambition has only grown and grown,
just as the gap between her
and her
undefeated rival has shrunk.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to win against someone like
this—I couldn't have done it
without you.
So I had to let you know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, now that I say it out loud,
it's kind of
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Must be your newfound confidence
talking. Next race, you're taking
first.
We'll beat Bourbon together.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Must be your newfound confidence
talking. Next race, you're taking
first.
We'll beat Bourbon together.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Together... Yeah, we can do it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Never been so amused in my life!
What about you, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
it was like a land of dreams. I had so
much fun. ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks for the treat today. I'll
keep up the hard work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Looks like someone had a magical time. I
suppose you were right to
bring her here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...But do make sure your next treat is a
bit
more proper.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I-I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following day, Rice dives back into
training with renewed vigor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just keep following,
just keep following...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ooh! She's hanging in there!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
McQueen keeps upping the pace, but Rice
isn't falling behind.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's what happens when you set a clear
goal for yourself. It helps
bring out the
best in you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's what happens when you set a clear
goal for yourself. It helps
bring out the
best in you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Especially so in her case, it looks like.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Especially so in her case, it looks like.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
By a clear goal, you mean McQueen? Or
Mihono Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Not just them. When Rice sets her mind to
something, she never gives
up on it—no
matter what it is.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Not just them. When Rice sets her mind to
something, she never gives
up on it—no
matter what it is.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh. I gotchu.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At this rate,
she'll be able to give her best
performance yet in her
rematch with
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The training will do some good for
McQueen too, who has the
Takarazuka
Kinen coming up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice seems to be lifting the entire team
higher. But sometimes, reality
drags you
back down.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: McQueen?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her desperate cry echoes across the
track...
